From 2015 to 2026: The Data Engineer Journey
The data engineering landscape has evolved dramatically.
In 2015, the focus was on building strong fundamentals:
 🔹 SQL
 🔹 Python
 🔹 Linux
 🔹 Git
 🔹 System Design
☁️ Cloud: AWS • Azure • GCP
 🔄 Transformation: dbt • SQL • Apache NiFi
 🤖 AI/ML: OpenAI • MLflow • Hugging Face
 ✅ Best Practices: Testing • Monitoring • Data Quality • Documentation
The biggest lesson: the fundamentals still matter.
 The tools change, but strong SQL, programming, data modeling, system design, and problem-solving remain the foundation.
